shared: Unified GGB art direction: hand-drawn dark gray outlines with varying weight, broad angular painted shading, restrained dry-brush texture, muted purple-gray shadows, ivory paper and fabric. Match supplied actual standing-character and book illustrations. No photorealistic leather, photographic paper, glossy 3D rendering or excessive golden filigree. Clear Korean UI lettering is typeset, not distressed. Decorative wear stays at edges. These are design proposals, not new canonical puzzle solutions.

boards.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one wide 16:9 GGB map screen. Image1 is reference ONLY for a hand-drawn overhead architectural FLOOR PLAN on aged paper, NOT its room names or navigation. Image2 defines illustrated ivory paper, worn edges, lavender shading; image3 defines hand painted line quality only, NO character on map. Large single open sheet occupies screen, subdued dark manor visible just at edges. Top left title '지도', small subtitle '발견한 공간'; top right clear '닫기 Esc'. Center a simple connected overhead floor plan sample of four rooms with actual walls, door gaps and a short corridor: '현관 홀' bottom center, '서재 복도' center, '외부 서고' upper left, '기록 내실' upper right. Room names clear graphite on clean paper, no dark filled cards. Show exactly ONE small solid BLACK CIRCLE inside 현관 홀, with tiny nearby text '현 위치'; the dot must not cover the room name. A tiny legend near top reads '● 현 위치'. Known locked door at 기록 내실 gets small outlined padlock at doorway, no colored marker. Discovered outline only, no mystery rooms or dashed undiscovered layout. Lower-left small unobtrusive caption '공간 배치 예시'. NO right sidebar, NO right tabs, NO bottom list, NO floor-selection strip, NO bottom carousel, NO character portraits, NO colored current-location pin. Preserve quiet uncluttered 2D drawn plan feeling and generous ivory whitespace.

Use case: style-transfer. Image1 is edit target and exact information hierarchy to preserve. Image2/3 are the user's actual illustrated book style, image4 actual character painting style. Repaint the notebook and all object thumbnails as hand-drawn broad painted forms matching refs. Make the two main reading columns feel like an open ivory book with subtle central binding and a slim purple ribbon at the seam; keep page planes FLAT enough for horizontal crisp UI lettering. Preserve ALL existing Korean labels, four tabs, search/filter, left evidence list, right original and observation, three buttons, bottom comparison basket, close button and pause status. Keep layout and readability. Replace photographic distressed parchment with smooth ivory illustrated paper and light purple-gray edge shadows, visible dark uneven outlines and tiny painted scuffs on corners. Replace shiny brass UI frames with fine charcoal/brown drawn lines, purple ribbon accent for selected tab. Keep evidence drawing as illustrative clock/line sketch, no new puzzle rules. Background softly painted gothic manor with muted violet/teal rather than photorealistic library. NO characters inside notebook. Clean typography, no text over texture, no tilted text, no new features.

Use case: style-transfer. Image1 is exact HUD layout and dialogue presentation to preserve. Image2 is the ACTUAL protagonist; preserve her face, costume, peach/black twintails, violet eyes, spotted witch hat, blue bow and skull doll, faithful to the original brushwork rather than redesigning. Use this protagonist waist-up large on LEFT matching Image1's occupied region. Image3/4 define object rendering. Repaint the whole environment, inventory objects and notebook to match the protagonist and book's 2D hand-drawn outlines and broad painted shade shapes. Remove photorealistic rendering and gold metallic frames. Gothic manor remains dark violet/teal with low-detail soft brush textures. Keep menu/current location top-left, five-slot inventory at same right edge visibly DIMMED with label '대화 중', notebook bottom-left now the small closed purple-ribbon BOOK icon rather than a loose document, labeled '수첩 N'. Keep atmospheric black gradient and hand-drawn dark foliage lower corners, NO rectangular dialogue box. Name diamond now reads '주인공'; exact dialogue '이 종이는 어디에서 찾았나요?' and '위쪽에 작은 홈이 있네요.' Body large ivory clear text. Preserve '자동 끔', '대화 기록 H', '다음 Enter' and next diamond; no overlapping controls or character face. Maintain all anchors and no extra characters.

Use case: stylized-concept. Produce a text-free wide 16:9 background layer for GGB's interactive title screen. Image1 is ONLY composition reference for dark gothic library, menu negative space on LEFT and a standing character that will be composited separately on RIGHT. Image2/3 define hand-drawn illustrated style: broad painted cel-like shadows, uneven dark outlines, subtle dry brush. Render ONLY the empty environment, NO character at all, NO text, NO logo, NO UI, NO borders. Dark gothic manor library, tall pointed window near center-right, dim shelves framing sides, few candle lights and restrained purple/teal ambient light. Left 45 percent especially calm, dark and low detail for clear future logo and vertical buttons. Right 55 percent also dark enough behind an ivory/peach-haired foreground character. Match illustrated books and anime standing art, do not make photorealistic, no 3D gloss, no photographic material noise. Camera front-facing; beautiful moody hand-painted game environment.
